CPC2017N had no littelfuse.com capture; it came from a 2023 Wayback capture of the old ixysic.com PDF (DS-CPC2017N-R06).

Lifecycle read from Wayback captures (Jan-Jun 2026) of the littelfuse.com product pages: all 15 base parts 'Product Status: Active'. PCN EIC-1159 (2025-10-01, metallization change, no LTB) lists every part and package variant here. LAA110 is not EOL.

CPC11xx/CPC2xxx datasheets list only the tube part and the TR reel suffix (one row each). LAA110/LBB110/LCC110 list DIP (no suffix), S (surface-mount gull-wing) and P (flatpack) variants plus TR reels; one row per package variant.

All CPC11xx share one 4-pin SOP drawing (footprint 'close', same as the CPC10xx catalog); all CPC2xxx share one 8-pin SOIC drawing (KiCad footprint was generated from the CPC2014N sheet, 'exact'). L-series S/P variants map to KiCad's IXYS_SMD-8 / IXYS_Flatpak-8 footprints whose pads match the datasheet land patterns exactly.
For Form B parts, led_operate_current is the max LED current to open the contact; turn_on/turn_off are as labelled in the datasheet.
RoHS from the Pb-free/RoHS/e3 logos on each datasheet p1.
KiCad symbol defect: Relay_SolidState:LBB110 (extends TLP222A-2) draws normally-open MOSFETs; pinout is correct but the graphic shows Form A.
